records.evidence: Order No. 95 consolidated publication 07/08/2024, article 3 paragraph 2, says აგვისტოს მესამე შაბათიდან. The same ordinal is repeated in Annex 1 for Gallinago gallinago, Coturnix coturnix, Columba palumbus, Columba livia, Columba oenas, and Streptopelia turtur. MEPA news 26537 dated 24/07/2026 says აგვისტოს მეოთხე შაბათს and gives 22 August 2026 through 1 March 2027. 22 August 2026 is the fourth Saturday of that month. Neither formulation is published.

Order No. 95 article 3 paragraph 7 prohibits hunting in state reserves and national parks and in their surrounding 500-meter zone. MEPA news 26537 says 500 meters around state reserves and 250 meters around national parks. No buffer polygon is generated.
